name: Microgrid mode-change rejection indication
summary: Reports that a requested operating-mode change failed its defined entry conditions.
description: Reports that a requested operating-mode change failed its defined entry conditions. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Mode request and failed prerequisites” at the input and “Mode-change rejection” at the output. The rejected condition should remain identifiable.
